interventions.action: Ran `npm run build` (which runs Next's typegen) before re-running `npx tsc --noEmit`, instead of running tsc directly after init.
interventions.reason: A standalone `tsc --noEmit` failed with TS2304 `Cannot find name 'LayoutProps'`. init's plan runs `next typegen` and then discards `.next`, so the generated route types are gone until a build or typegen recreates them. Nothing printed by init or the guides says to regenerate them.

interventions.action: Removed the create-next-app Geist and Geist_Mono `next/font/google` loaders and their className from app/layout.tsx, and replaced the placeholder metadata with Larder's title and description.
interventions.reason: Nothing reads the `--font-geist-*` variables: the theme's `--ult-font-sans` names Figtree. They only preloaded unused Google font files. init kept them and its report said nothing about them.

interventions.action: Installed playwright-core in ./.scratch/verify, outside the app, and drove /usr/bin/chromium against `next start`. Ran it with TMPDIR pointed at a short temporary directory under /tmp, which was deleted right after the run.
interventions.reason: The guidance asks for computed-value and interaction checks in a production build but names no tool. Chromium aborted with 'Socket path too long' because the sandbox's TMPDIR is longer than the Unix socket path limit.

decisions.choice: Accept the theme's documented fallback font stack and load no Figtree or IBM Plex Mono files.
options: Load Figtree through next/font/google. It emits a hashed family name, so it would need an app-level --ult-font-sans override and a fetch from Google at build time.
Self-host Figtree font files with an @font-face rule
decisions.why: The export 'carries font stacks but loads no font files. Load each chosen face in the application or accept the documented fallback.' The fallback keeps every font value inside the theme file and needs no external host. The rendered face is the system sans rather than Figtree.

decisions.choice: Put the layout breakpoint in the app's token module as `stylex.defineConsts` (components/pantry/pantry.stylex.ts, `breakpoints.wide`), next to the defineVars group for `--app-size-content-max`.
options: A named module constant in the screen file, as the Principles section and the Projects lesson do
A defineConsts entry in the application's token module
decisions.why: The brief requires that no lengths be decided outside theme and token modules. Ultima's convention puts the media-query length in the component file. defineConsts satisfies both, since StyleX accepts it as a media-query key, and the StyleX lint and `ultima-design check` both accept it.

decisions.choice: Choose the category with the portalled Select (Select.Portal to document.body) inside an inline form Card, rather than opening the form in a Dialog.
options: Portalled Select in an inline form
decisions.why: The brief allows either. An inline form keeps the intake-desk flow on one screen. The Select's default body portal inherits the root CSS theme, which was verified in all four modes.

decisions.choice: Mark the selected stock row with its trailing Button switching to variant 'solid' (brand accent) plus aria-current, while the other rows use variant 'outline'.
options: Button variant swap (Item recipe rows with a trailing action)
Toggle Group or Radio Group for single selection
A painted row background from accent-subtle
decisions.why: The Item recipe says a row that acts should be a catalogue control composition. Picking a supported variant comes before overriding styles, and it keeps the brand accent on selection while the warning tone stays reserved for 'Running low'.

review.notes: No documentation rendering, data-link decoding or JavaScript-bundle extraction. All five guides, three lesson bundles and the Item recipe were fetched over HTTP. Guessed /components/*.md paths returned 404, and a curl of /components/select returned the SPA shell; the agent used llms.txt APIs and installed source. Only the harness rendered Theme Studio. Production, check, lint and raw-paint assertions passed. Font removal and route type regeneration reproduce #811; the shorter Chromium TMPDIR is an environment workaround. The breakpoint-location ambiguity needs separate triage. Documented font fallback and product choices about selection and form placement are excluded.
